rationale: The interpreter accurately captures the ticket's core requirement to populate cooling circuits, sum their heights into the DX Coil Height, and update the total when a circuit height is edited. However, several ambiguities remain unresolved regarding units, valid ranges, precision, source of initial values, and behavior when circuits are added or removed. These open ambiguities must be clarified before implementation can proceed.

findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the units to be used for circuit heights and the DX coil height.

findings.description: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.
findings.action: Clarify the acceptable range, minimum increment, and decimal precision for circuit heights and the resulting DX coil height.

sourceRefs.quote: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.

findings.description: The source and format of starting circuit values are unspecified.
findings.action: Ask the ticket owner to specify how initial circuit heights are provided (e.g., default values, data import, user entry) and in what format.

sourceRefs.quote: The source and format of starting circuit values are unspecified.

findings.description: Behavior when circuits are added or removed is unspecified.
findings.action: Clarify how the system should handle dynamic addition or removal of cooling circuits and how the DX coil height should be recalculated in those cases.

sourceRefs.quote: Behavior when circuits are added or removed is unspecified.

resolutions.rationale: The interpreter now includes the requirement to recalculate and update DX Coil Information when a Circuit Height is edited, satisfying the ticket's stated behavior.

sourceRefs.quote: Editing any Circuit Height recalculates the sum and updates DX Coil Information.
